## About
Ferndale Auto Radiator Repair sits on historic Woodward Avenue, home of the annual Dream Cruise. We've been fixing radiators for folks around Detroit for generations, and we like to say we were your grandfather's radiator shop.
Mel, the owner, does the work. Classic car owners bring us original radiators to repair or re-core, and we also stock current radiator tanks, gaskets and internal transmission and oil coolers for newer cars. Before you buy an aftermarket radiator for a cracked inlet tank, give us a call and we'll talk through your options.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 53 reviews.

## Services
- Classic radiator repair and re-core work: We repair or re-core original radiators for classic and vintage cars.
- Radiator tanks and parts: We keep current radiator tanks and their parts in stock, including plastic tanks, gaskets and internal transmission and oil coolers.
- Heater cores: Heater cores repaired, or replaced with new.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need a new radiator if my tank is cracked?
A: Not always. A cracked inlet tank can often be replaced without buying a whole aftermarket radiator. Call us to talk through your options.

Q: Can you improve my cooling?
A: In some cases, yes. We may be able to increase your radiator's cooling capacity.

Q: Do you work with other shops?
A: Yes. We do both wholesale and retail work.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
